### Function
- 「...~ 」*qualifier:* -like, -y, -ful (adjective marker)
### Semanticization
*Appending a [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Grammar/(tse)\|tse]] glyph yields **[[Sen'fi/Glossary/Concepts/aan\|aan]]***
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- ideograph of a thing with a label attached to it -> labelling -> describing.
